decisions.boundary_condition: Apply this per room and do not infer it from the number of travelers or requested rooms.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer a queen-size bed for a shared hotel room when no separate-bed arrangement is requested; accept a king-size bed as a larger alternative.
decisions.condition: When selecting a shared hotel room without an explicit request for separate beds.
decisions.default_action: Prefer a room with a queen-size bed; a king-size bed may be accepted when offered as a larger alternative.
decisions.exception_condition: Honor explicit twin-bed, separate-bed, or other room-specific sleeping arrangements instead.
decisions.name: queen_bed_for_shared_hotel_room
decisions.preference_value: Prefer a queen-size bed for a shared hotel room when no separate-bed arrangement is requested.
decisions.rationale: The frozen representative expresses a reusable, longitudinal room-bed default with explicit boundaries and exceptions. The evidence supports a queen bed as the soft default for a shared room, permits a king as a larger alternative, and preserves explicit separate-bed arrangements.
